headline: Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan and new Saudi Ambassador Dr Rajeh Albugamy discussed the early signing and implementation of the Pakistan-GCC Free Trade Agreement in Islamabad, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Jam Kamal aur Saudi safeer Dr Rajeh Albugamy ki Islamabad mein mulaqat

caption:
Pakistan-GCC Free Trade Agreement jaldi sign karne par zor!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan aur naye Saudi safeer Dr Rajeh Albugamy ne Islamabad mein mulaqat mein Pakistan-GCC FTA ko jaldi sign aur implement karne par baat ki. Minister ne kaha is se market access aur bilateral trade barhegi.
